title: Extract facet-to-field mapping as reusable guard extension point
context: nuryel_write is a fourth auto-committing tool with identical worktree-misroute exposure as the three already-guarded tools (hunch_record_decision/_correction/_finding), but was left uncovered. Round 1 (commit c3251612) guarded decisions/findings/bugs but, per mr-complexity-reviewer's round-1 finding, missed constraints: a constraint's `scope` field (its glob list) is file-evidence in exactly the same role hunch_record_correction's scope_hint_file plays, and the reviewer reproduced a live misroute through nuryel_write with facet:"constraints". Round 2 (commit 837c1646) closed that gap and, per the reviewer's follow-up, converted the field lookup from an open-ended ternary chain into a total Record<StateFacet, string | null> map so a future facet added to STATE_FACETS without a guard-coverage decision is a compile error, not a silent gap. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job...); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic).
decision: Extract the facet-to-file-evidence-field mapping into an exported `FILE_EVIDENCE_FIELD: Record<StateFacet, string | null>` total map plus a `fileEvidenceFor` helper, so the existing `misrouteGuard` covers any facet that names files (decisions: related_files, findings/bugs: affected_files, constraints: scope) without embedding field-name knowledge in each tool's handler, and so adding a facet to STATE_FACETS without extending the map fails to typecheck.
consequences: nuryel_write's decisions/findings/bugs/constraints facets are all protected from committing to the wrong worktree when cwd is omitted

The facet-to-field-name mapping is a TOTAL map, not an open-ended ternary chain — a facet added to STATE_FACETS without a guard decision is a compile error, closing the exact mechanism that left constraints unguarded in round 1
fileEvidenceFor is exported so tests can assert the mapping directly (exhaustively, over every STATE_FACETS entry) instead of only probing it through live misroute behavior
Future auto-committing tools can reuse the same guard pattern without duplication
bugs facet is protected even though the three older hunch_record_* tools never wrote it (consistent coverage)
alternatives_rejected: Duplicate misrouteGuard logic in nuryel_write's handler (code duplication, divergence risk)
Create a separate guard function specific to nuryel_write (unnecessary proliferation)
Leave nuryel_write unguarded but document it separately (silently defers the hazard)

Keep the facet-to-field mapping as an open-ended ternary chain (round-1 shape) — a new facet added to STATE_FACETS still typechecks clean with zero guard coverage, which is exactly how constraints went unguarded
